title: Acetylcholine demixes heterogeneous dopamine signals for learning and moving
goal: Reproduce the complete original Figure 6h fast-versus-slow contralateral reaction-time decoding result from DMS spiking under the Figure 6g method boundary, including the source example traces and all eighteen qualifying sessions from eight rats. Preserve the source cohort, labels, input window, folds, penalty selection and aggregation. Report the historical result as selected within-session cross-validation performance. Assess candidate improvement only under a separately qualified comparison; a higher selected score alone does not establish scientific superiority, independent-test generalization, cross-rat transfer or causal demixing.

success_criteria: Assess reproduction and improvement independently under reproduction.v2.json and improvement.v1.json; do not combine their scores.

Use outcomes.v1.json for the matched information conditions and budgets; a declared contract or admitted receipt is not scientific qualification.
